title: Global Extrema of the Zeta Regularized Determinant on Orthogonal Flat Tori
summary: The search for extremal geometries is a central theme in several areas of mathematics. Here, we address the following question: among all n-dimensional orthogonal tori of unit volume, which one maximizes the zeta regularized determinant of the Laplacian? We prove that the equilateral torus is the unique maximizer in each dimension n, for all n greater than or equal to 2, validating Sarnak's conjecture in this context.
